annotations.text:
Structure, not decoration.

The window is 680 wide with a 176px measured sidebar and a 108px control gutter reserved on every row, so a label or hint can never run under its own value box.

Row heights derive from your font size, as they do in the shipped code.

The real test: 19 settings in one section.

Grouping (MARKER / BEAM / GLOW) is the change that matters here. Nineteen flat rows is a list you scan; five groups is a list you navigate.

Hovered row + tooltip shown as they behave in game: GameTooltip anchors to the right of the window.

Search already works across every section in the shipped build. What is missing is feedback: match counts, dimmed sections with no hit, and the matched word picked out in the row.

Everything here is buildable on 3.3.5a: flat fills, 1px borders, square corners. No rounded corners, no blur.

Standalone: no GW2 UI installed.

pfQuest keeps its own signature teal #33FFCC, and theme.lua also uses a lighter panel body (#121217 against GW2's #0A0A0B) at 0.85 alpha rather than 0.92.

Same layout, same metrics. Only the palette moves, and the addon already switches automatically on IsAddOnLoaded("GW2_UI").
